capability.summary: Detects geometric contact between two supplied spherical rigid-body snapshots and returns contact observation evidence.

model.name: Sphere–sphere geometric narrowphase
model.formulation: Compares center separation with the sum of the two radii and produces a contact observation when the declared tolerance criterion is met.
assumptions: Bodies are represented by spheres for this query.
Rigid-body snapshots and radii are supplied by the caller.
The detector evaluates one pair per call.
model.timeModel: Caller-supplied step index and elapsed time are recorded as observation context; this provider does not advance time.
validity: Input radii and body states must satisfy the underlying detector's validation contract.

hostResponsibilities: Supply current body snapshots and radii.
Own logical time and world-step ordering.
Resolve the typed provider interface from the loaded bundle instance.

validation: Focused tests cover bundle identity/provider declaration and detector delegation.
knownGaps: No broadphase implementation is provided by this adapter.
A detected contact is geometric evidence, not a resolved collision.

learningObjectives: Distinguish broadphase candidate generation from narrowphase geometric contact detection.
Explain why contact evidence and collision response are separate operations.
